method: Review pinned vendor source and historical documentation offline. Source-authored synthetic fixtures and explicit boundary controls precede engine execution. No measurement callbacks are requested.
limitations: All checks are producer-profile warnings. None proves remote acceptance or complete collector coverage.
Only default exact hosts and reviewed routes are claimed. Configured domains and adjacent transports remain excluded.
The 2010 official document establishes a historical template only. Current service availability after migration is unverified.
Bare shareasale.com is the evidenced image host. q.cfm and www host are not inferred from the separate socket example.

implemented_scope.display_name: ShareASale legacy sale and lead template
implemented_scope.description: Warning-only checks for the archived official sale.cfm image template for per-sale and per-lead programs. The document is historical; current collector support after migration is unverified. PPC programs, the separately approved q.cfm socket method, extensions, account permissions and delivery are outside this profile.

params.name: amount
params.description: The legacy template supplies the sale subtotal. Lead also supplies amount, including the documented 0.00 example. No sign or precision constraint is inferred.

params.name: tracking
params.description: The legacy order or lead identifier is opaque and may contain email-like text. No issued-ID, numeric or UUID grammar is imposed.

params.name: merchantID
params.description: The template supplies the merchant identifier. Issuance, numeric spelling, length and account state remain external.

params.name: transtype
params.description: These are the two program types in this explicitly legacy sale/lead image-template profile. Other protocols are not covered.

params.name: method
params.description: The historical image producer uses GET. This does not describe the separately approved socket endpoint.
